text: From the streets of South Auckland to becoming the first global superstar of rugby, Jonah Lomu's journey inspired millions. Yet behind the power, speed, and legend was a deeply human story of family, faith, identity, resilience, and sacrifice.
why: Finds the human story instead of pasting the press release. No cast list, no superlatives.
